prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1372; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Our client was struck while proceeding through the intersection and has suffered physical injuries that are still being evaluated by treating providers. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide a copy of the declarations page and confirm in writing the amounts available.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair and total loss records, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, and any traffic camera or third-party footage in your possession. Please confirm in writing that a litigation hold has been placed on these materials. We look forward to your prompt response.
